summary.headline: Spot VIX stayed near 15 while October carry held; correction hedges were added at Oct21/23 and Dec20 but ordinary stress remained supplied.
key_points: Oct25C is now OI-confirmed fresh ordinary-stress supply after Friday's 20k sale and Monday same-side continuation.
The Oct21/23/30 call-buy cluster contributed about +$24.2M signed VIX delta; excluding it flips the daily headline negative.
December carries the strongest deferred correction demand, especially 19-20, while lower puts help finance the book.
Friday's Feb20C/P movement book and Mar26P low-VIX financing were confirmed by OI, supporting a defined-convexity barbell.
summary.daily_note: BUY/SELL is transaction side, not proof of opening/closing. Monday structures require the next OI snapshot for position-state confirmation.

leave_one_out.comment: The positive daily signed-delta headline is not robust; the 18:39 October correction cluster alone exceeds the total day delta.
